children: WASHINGTON (dpa-AFX) - Graco Inc (GGG) announced earnings for third quarter that Drops, from the same period last year
The company's earnings totaled $121.56 million, or $0.75 per share.  This compares with $137.63 million, or $0.82 per share, last year.
Excluding items, Graco Inc reported adjusted earnings of $131.3 million or $0.81 per share for the period.
The company's revenue for the period rose 7.9% to $586.4 million from $543.4 million last year.
